data.description:
## Story DD Coverage
- dd-1: (outbound, update) with status delta missing from local_to_jira_status → orchestrator raises StatusMappingError and exits non-zero BEFORE any applier leaf runs
- dd-4: Unit tests written and passing

## Testing Mode
RED

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: pytest -xvs tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_status_preflight.py
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: make lint-ruff
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: make format-check
- [ ] StatusMappingError raised when an update mutation references a status absent from local_to_jira_status
  Verify: pytest -xvs tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_status_preflight.py::test_missing_status_raises_before_applier
- [ ] Applier.apply is NOT called when preflight raises (spy applier records zero invocations)
  Verify: pytest -xvs tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_status_preflight.py::test_applier_not_invoked_on_preflight_failure
- [ ] All mapped statuses pass preflight without raising
  Verify: pytest -xvs tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_status_preflight.py::test_mapped_status_passes_preflight
- [ ] Empty-dict config disables feature gracefully when no update mutations have status field (kill-switch)
  Verify: pytest -xvs tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_status_preflight.py::test_empty_config_kill_switch
- [ ] Empty-dict config + status-bearing update raises StatusMappingError (operator explicit-disable signal)
  Verify: pytest -xvs tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_status_preflight.py::test_empty_config_with_status_update_raises
- [ ] TODO breadcrumb in reconcile.py references sibling story cde1-30ba for direction-field tightening
  Verify: grep -F 'cde1-30ba' plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/reconcile.py
- [ ] Existing reconcile_once tests still pass
  Verify: pytest -xvs tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_reconcile_once.py

## Implementation Notes
In plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/reconcile.py, BEFORE the call to applier.apply(mutations, pass_id, repo_root) at line 96, insert preflight:

```python
from .config import local_to_jira_status  # or via _load_config pattern
from .applier import StatusMappingError

for m in mutations:
    if m.get('action') == 'update' and 'status' in m.get('fields', {}):
        target = m['fields']['status']
        if target not in local_to_jira_status:
            raise StatusMappingError(
                f"local status '{target}' on mutation key {m.get('key')!r} "
                f"has no entry in local_to_jira_status; refusing to dispatch "
                f"any applier leaf (see ticket cde1-30ba: once direction field "
                f"is added, tighten this predicate to direction=='outbound')"
            )
```

The TODO breadcrumb is a literal substring 'cde1-30ba' in the comment — the AC grep verifies it survives.

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: Preflight status-mapping scan in reconcile.py raises StatusMappingError
